exposure: maternal educational status (inability to read and write)
mode of birth (instrumental delivery, cesarean section)
cohort: The study included 456 mothers in the immediate postpartum period with short and recommended pregnancy intervals from public hospitals in East Gojjam, Northwest Ethiopia.
finding: The overall prevalence of adverse birth outcomes was 23.9%, with a significantly higher prevalence in mothers with short pregnancy intervals (29.4%) compared to those with recommended intervals (18.4%).
mod_finding: Instrumental delivery and cesarean section were significantly associated with adverse birth outcomes.
